title: Run Map Your Spend
done: Your Map Your Spend report is built on the last 12 full months of books and closings
goal: Run Map Your Spend on the last 12 full months.

claude.title: Export 12 full months of books
claude.detail: A general ledger or transaction detail export is best, and a P&L works. Use the export guide for your books in this week's Kit.

claude.text: Connected to QuickBooks in Week 0? Export the ledger once anyway. The QuickBooks connector's P&L looks to come back by account, not by vendor, and the map needs vendors.

claude.title: Add card statements if you need them
claude.detail: Only if your books don't list each card charge one by one. If they do, leave the statements out, or the charges count twice.

claude.title: Pull 12 months of closings with GCI
claude.detail: From Sisu if it's connected, or a closings export with the GCI on each deal from Sisu, Follow Up Boss, Brivity or your brokerage.

claude.title: Black out full card and bank numbers
claude.detail: Do this before any file goes in. The skill reads your books and never changes them.

claude.title: Save the files in your inbox folder
claude.detail: In Google Drive, make AI Office / Map Your Spend, with an inbox folder and a reports folder inside. Put this week's exports in the inbox.

claude.title: Run Map Your Spend
claude.detail: Open your AI Office project in Claude and start a new chat. Attach your files, paste this, and fill in the brackets.

button.label: Copy prompt
button.text:
Run Map Your Spend on our books for the last 12 full months. Use the map-your-spend skill.
Our team is [team name]. The attached files are [list each file: the ledger or transaction detail export, any card statements, and the closings export].
Before you start, tell me the four guardrails. Then read the files, map every line to the Standard Chart, and ask me every question you need in one message. Wait for my answers before you score.
Read only. Never change the books. Never send.

claude.text: If Claude says it can't run code, stop. Turn on code execution and file creation in Settings, then run it again. The skill never guesses a number.

claude.title: About This Step
paras: This week maps twelve months of your books onto Connor's Standard Chart and hires your Finance Analyst. At the live build, you put it on a monthly schedule. After the books close each month, it puts last month's numbers on your Owner Desk.
The operator pulls the files and runs the skill. The owner answers the flags in step 2. Run it by Tuesday night, so you can submit your report for a live read on Wednesday.

claude.title: The Four Guardrails
paras: The skill says these before any upload:
Model training off, or a Team plan.
Full card and bank account numbers blacked out.
It reads the books and never changes them.
Check every category before you trust a percentage.

paras: Use whichever your stack card says for each source.

Export (Yellow)

title: Answer the Flags
done: Every flag answered and the totals by bucket confirmed
goal: Answer every flag and confirm the totals by bucket.

claude.title: Answer the Flags
claude.note: Recording w1-02 (one cut for both paths; the chat looks the same on both).

claude.title: Answer every flag
claude.detail: The skill lists each line it could not place, with a plain question. Answer each one in the same chat. If you don't know, say so.

claude.title: Check the lines it moved
claude.detail: It lists the lines it gave a different home than your books did, biggest first, like portal fees out of advertising or VAs out of software. Say if any home is wrong.

claude.title: Confirm the totals by bucket
claude.detail: Compare each bucket's total with your books. A wrong total caught now is a wrong report you never see.

claude.title: Answer the questions files can't
claude.detail: How many agents. How many staff, contractors and VAs fill a seat. Whether you sell, and whether you're paid a commission on your own deals. How many files your outside transaction coordinator handled. Skip any you can't answer.

claude.text: If you sell and aren't paid a commission on your own deals, the report restates your books to pay you one. That is usually where profit drops. Connor walks through it at the live build.

claude.title: Answer the income sign question
claude.detail: Only if the skill asks. When one file shows income both ways, it stops and asks how that file shows a commission deposit. Look at one deposit in the file and tell it.

claude.title: Let it map and score again
claude.detail: Once you've answered, the skill puts your answers into the map and scores again. Read the new totals before you go on.

claude.title: About This Step
paras: The flags are the point. Every team has a few lines nobody can explain, and answering them is often the first time an owner sees the spend sorted the same way twice.
This step is the owner's. The operator can sit with you and type.

claude.title: What Flags Look Like (Made-Up Sample Team)
paras: These come with the skill's made-up Sample Team. Your questions will be about your own vendors.
head: Flag
The Answer
rows: J Alvarez, in Ask My Accountant
A video editor, paid monthly as a contractor
The taco truck for open house weekends
A referral fee Zillow takes out of the commission at closing
On the owner's card: the golf club

claude.title: Three Things to Watch For
paras: The income sign on mixed files: one file showing income both as positive and negative numbers.
Card charges counted twice, when the ledger already lists them one by one.
A leader who sells but takes no commission.

title: Read Your Six Lines
done: You know which lines are on, watch or off, and the one gap you'll act on this month
goal: Read your six lines: on, watch or off, and the gaps in dollars.

claude.title: Reading Your Report
claude.note: Recording w1-03 (one cut for both paths; the report is the same file on both).

claude.title: Open your report
claude.detail: Double-click the report file. It opens in your browser, with no internet needed, on a laptop or a phone.

claude.title: Read your six lines
claude.detail: Each line is a share of GCI, marked on, watch or off. Check each one as you read it.

claude.title: Read the gaps in dollars
claude.detail: Biggest first. Each gap comes with the standard's first move.

claude.title: Switch between As Booked and Restated
claude.detail: As Booked is what your books show. Restated books revenue gross and pays the leader a commission. The difference is the part of profit that was really cost of sale or the leader's paycheck.

claude.title: Pick the one gap you'll act on
claude.detail: One gap, this month. Write it down for the commit at the end of the live build.

claude.text: Use the What If sliders to size the one gap. They never change your numbers, and Reset To Actual puts them back.

claude.title: About This Step
paras: One chart, one standard and every gap in dollars is how you know what to fix first. Your books grew one account at a time, so this is likely the first time you've seen your spend sorted this way.

claude.title: The Standard Chart
paras: Connor's standard. Every line is a share of GCI. The 30% is after the leader is paid a commission.
head: Line
Rule
Standard

claude.title: On, Watch and Off
paras: Company dollar, advertising, total operating cost and net operating income are hard lines. On meets the number. Off does not.
Staffing and all other operating cost are "about" lines. On is at or under the number. Watch is up to 1 point over. Off is past that.
Low staffing or low advertising is never a flag on its own.

claude.title: The Play: The Standard's First Moves
paras: Fix splits and lead cost before you cut people.
Staffing over 10%: give the repeat work to an AI Employee or a VA.
Advertising over 5%: pull cost per closing by source first, which is Week 2.
All other cost over 5%: audit software and occupancy.

title: Schedule the Finance Analyst
done: The Finance Analyst is on its monthly schedule, has run once, and its first numbers are on your Owner Desk
goal: Schedule the Finance Analyst and read its first numbers on your Owner Desk.

claude.title: Save the report and the team file
claude.detail: In the report chat, paste this. Claude saves with the Google Drive connector, using the create file tool you left on in Week 0.

button.label: Copy prompt
button.text:
Using Google Drive, save the report and team-file.json to AI Office / Map Your Spend. Keep the file name team-file.json exactly. Then tell me the full path of each file you saved.
Don't change or delete anything else in Google Drive.

claude.title: Check both files are in the folder
claude.detail: Open AI Office / Map Your Spend in Google Drive. You should see the report and team-file.json. Every monthly run starts from that file, so keep its name and keep one copy.

claude.title: Pick the day it runs
claude.detail: The 5th of each month is the default, with last month's files in by the 4th. If your books close later, pick the day after they close, and change "the 5th" in the prompt to match.

claude.title: Schedule the Finance Analyst
claude.detail: In the Claude app, set up a scheduled task and paste the prompt. Fill in the brackets and keep only the line for your team.

button.label: Copy prompt
button.text:
You are our Finance Analyst. You report to [OWNER'S NAME]. You run on a schedule with nobody watching, so follow these steps exactly.
Run the Map Your Spend monthly run for [TEAM NAME]. Use the map-your-spend skill and follow references/monthly.md. The team file is AI Office / Map Your Spend / team-file.json.
First run: if AI Office / Map Your Spend / reports has no monthly report yet, run the newest full month in the team file, using the files already in AI Office / Map Your Spend / inbox.
Every run after that: run last month. If today is before the 5th, or last month's report is already in the reports folder, reply "Nothing to run" and stop.
[Connected teams, keep this line:] After the first run, pull last month from QuickBooks and Sisu. If either doesn't answer, say so and use the files in AI Office / Map Your Spend / inbox instead.
[Export teams, keep this line:] After the first run, last month's files are in AI Office / Map Your Spend / inbox.
Map the month, score it with --month for that month, and build the report. Save the report in AI Office / Map Your Spend / reports, and save the updated team file back to AI Office / Map Your Spend.
Then add a note, with today's date, to the top of AI Office / Owner Desk: the month, the headline, what moved more than 2 points, anything new that needs a home, the one decision, and where the report is saved. Don't change or delete anything else on the page.
If the month's files are missing, say what is missing and where to drop it in that note, and stop. Never fill a missing month with guesses. If anything else fails or looks wrong, say what you saw in the note and stop before scoring.
Read only. You may save drafts, save files in the AI Office and post to its desk pages. Never send an email. Never change the books, a lead, or anything else in a connected app. Don't change or delete any file outside AI Office / Map Your Spend, except adding your note to the top of the Owner Desk.

claude.title: Set the day and time
claude.detail: Ask for the 5th of every month at 6:00 AM MT, or the day you picked. If Claude can only offer a weekly schedule, pick Mondays at 6:00 AM MT. The prompt skips a month it has already done. Leave the folder empty.

claude.title: Save the task and run it once
claude.detail: Make sure Google Drive and, for connected teams, QuickBooks and Sisu are on for the task. Click Schedule, then run it once now. Its first run uses the newest month in your team file, so you see real numbers today.

claude.title: Read the note on your Owner Desk
claude.detail: Open the Owner Desk. The newest note at the top has the date, the month, the headline, what moved more than 2 points, anything new that needs a home and one decision. Take a screenshot for your checkpoint.

claude.text: Its first run on its own comes on the next 5th, or the day you picked. If last month's books aren't in yet, it says what's missing and stops. Run it again once they are. Running the same month twice is safe.

claude.title: About This Step
paras: Your Finance Analyst is Map Your Spend on a monthly schedule. After the books close, it maps last month with the map you confirmed, shows what moved, and puts the numbers on your Owner Desk with one decision for the owner.
It reads and drafts. It never changes the books, and it never fills a missing month with guesses.
The team file holds your confirmed map, your team's answers and your numbers by month. Every monthly run starts from it.

claude.title: What Lands on the Owner Desk
paras: A short note with the date, at the top of the page. The full report is saved in AI Office / Map Your Spend / reports.
head: Line
What It Says
rows: Where your last 12 months stand against the standard
Any line that moved more than 2 points from the month before
Vendors the map had not seen, and any it could not place

A question about the month's biggest move. For the made-up Sample Team: "Advertising rose 4.1 points in October, from 6.3% to 10.4% of the month's GCI. Is that a one-month swing, or a change to act on now?"

It reads and drafts. It never changes the books, and it never fills a missing month with guesses.
The team file holds your confirmed map, your team's answers and your numbers by month. Every monthly run starts from it.

chatgpt.title: What Lands on the Owner Desk
paras: A short note with the date, at the top of the page. The full report is saved in AI Office / Map Your Spend / reports.
head: Line
What It Says
rows: Where your last 12 months stand against the standard
Any line that moved more than 2 points from the month before
Vendors the map had not seen, and any it could not place

A question about the month's biggest move. For the made-up Sample Team: "Advertising rose 4.1 points in October, from 6.3% to 10.4% of the month's GCI. Is that a one-month swing, or a change to act on now?"

chatgpt.title: Late Closes and Missed Months
paras: Books closed late? Run it again once they close. Running the same month twice is safe: that month's numbers are replaced, not added to.
Missed a month? Paste the prompt in a new chat in your AI Office project and add the month you want at the end.

done: The Finance Analyst's seat card is signed, with its minutes and first run
goal: Fill in the Finance Analyst's seat card and have the owner sign it.

claude.title: Fill in the Finance Analyst's seat card
claude.detail: Fill it in here, together. For Took Over, use your Week 0 baseline: Baseline task 1, getting last month's numbers in front of the owner. Write your minutes per occurrence, or "not done today." For First Run, use the date of the run you just did. A made-up team's finished card is in this week's Kit.

claude.title: Sign the seat card
claude.detail: Read it, then sign it in the form. Your signature says you know what it reads, what it drafts, who it reports to and what it can't do.

claude.title: Turn in your checkpoint
claude.detail: Upload a screenshot of the note on your Owner Desk before the next live build on Wed, Dec 9, 2026 at 12:00 PM MT. The signed seat card comes in through the form.
